syntax: bf(y ~ x + phylo(1 | species, tree = tree), sigma ~ 1), family = gaussian(), engine = "julia"
drmjl_status: DRM.jl first Gaussian phylo-mean path (Hopper Phase 1.5 #5)
claim_boundary: Route A Gaussian phylo-mean (sigma ~ 1). All four design/168 limbs met, and the row's DEFINING parameter -- the phylogenetic SD -- is now actually compared: drmTMB 0.916577447 (correlation scale) vs DRM.jl raw re_sd x sqrt(tree height), agreeing to 1.50e-08, plus a three-height round-trip (9.37e-08 / 1.44e-08 / 3.31e-08). Its test runs in the DEFAULT suite, not behind DRM_PARITY_TESTS. NOTE the scale convention: drmTMB standardises via ape::vcv(tree, corr=TRUE) and is height-invariant; DRM.jl reports on the RAW branch-length scale -- they agree only after x sqrt(height), and the difference is invisible on a height-1 tree. Fixture reseeded 2026-08-25 (seed 404) because the previous seed-111 cell's phylo SD was UNIDENTIFIABLE (profiled nll flat over 20 orders of magnitude), so its comparison passed inside tolerance while meaning nothing (DRM.jl#483). atol_re_sd re-derived a priori from drmTMB's Wald SE. NOT interval coverage; not loc-scale phylo; not non-Gaussian phylo.
next_action: Broaden beyond one seed; loc-scale and non-Gaussian phylo remain separate rows.

syntax: poisson()/nbinom2() with phylo(1 | group, tree = tree)
claim_boundary: Large-p phylogenetic random-intercept counts. Measured against native TMB at p = 20, 300, 1000 and 3000, all PARITY_PASS (coef 6.4e-08 to 1.0e-05; logLik ~1e-09). NARROW, and the boundary must stay visible: (a) the harness is R-side (tools/parity_classc*.R) with NO wired Julia test, so this is not a standing gate; (b) SE parity appears to LOOSEN from ~8e-06 relative at p=300 to ~1.5e-03 at p>=1000 while coef and logLik do not (DRM.jl#487, soft measurement -- the probe emitted display-rounded SEs); (c) p=3000 is two orders of magnitude below DRM.jl's own p=10,000 O(p) claim and NO native comparator has been attempted near that scale. NOTE the dense-O(p^3) premise is measurably false here: native TMB scaled O(p^1.27) over this range (DRM.jl#486), so this is genuine parity, not a DRM.jl-only reach. NOT interval coverage.
next_action: Wire a Julia-side gate; resolve the SE trend (#487) before any interval claim at scale.
